...Fufu, thank you very much. Hearing 
those words really puts my mind at ease.

Body and mind, everything fell into place 
perfectly. All that conditioning was well 
worth it.

today a perfect score.

text_block_list.text:
I see. Perhaps that, too, is what it means 
to be a good mentor...

choice_data_list_en: I knew for sure you'd come back with a win.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm learning a lot, in all sorts of 
ways.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall gladly accept your 
kindness.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And to make up for it, I'll be sure to 
live up to your expectations in the next 
race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now that body and mind are fully 
conditioned, our training efficiency will 
increase as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We must level up even more before the next 
race. Let us build a rock-solid 
foundation.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Results follow only through untiring 
dedication and study, after all.
